definitions.explanation: A fictional or hypothetical being from the planet Mars. Used in science fiction and popular culture, and sometimes figuratively to describe someone who seems completely out of touch or alien.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火星人|かせいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{火星人|かせいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I believed Martians really existed.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{火星人|かせいじん}⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧で、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}できない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: That person's way of thinking is like a Martian's — nobody can understand it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{火星|かせい}→火星：13412_kasei⟧ (Mars, the planet) and ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). Follows the productive pattern of planet name + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ to form hypothetical alien inhabitants: {金星人|きんせいじん} (Venusian), {木星人|もくせいじん} (Jovian), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火星人|かせいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{襲来|しゅうらい}→襲来：14156_shuurai⟧: Martian invasion
- {火星人|かせいじん}⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: like a Martian (figurative: alien, incomprehensible)
- {火星人|かせいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{攻|せ}めて→攻める：02123_semeru⟧くる: Martians are attacking

CULTURAL NOTE:
The concept of {火星人|かせいじん} became widespread through H.G. Wells' "The War of the Worlds" (1898), which was translated into Japanese. The classic image of a Martian with a large head and tentacles (タコ{型|がた}{火星人|かせいじん}, "octopus-type Martian") remains a staple of Japanese pop culture and manga.

RELATED WORDS:
- {宇宙人|うちゅうじん}: alien; extraterrestrial — the general term for any being from space
- {地球外生命体|ちきゅうがいせいめいたい}: extraterrestrial life — formal/scientific
